Review Text: Tried it recently and totallly fall in love with it. Can be making into soup and dry noodle. It has The spiciness and special Korean spices.

My personal favorite korean noodles because not only can you make it the normal way, I also like to cook it with less water and boil it for longer so the noodles are softer and the soup because more like a sauce. It's a good introduction noodle for people who want to try spicy food but can't really do spicy yet. It also has a very solid natural flavoring that's tasty and pairs well with any eggs and vegetables. Definitely recommend!
Notes / Annotator Comments: Texture, cooking method, flavour and suggested additions.

Review Text: Nongshim's Shin Ramyun Spicy instant noodles deliver the perfect blend of heat and heartiness. The rich, bold broth is packed with a satisfying kick of spice, balanced by savory flavors that feel indulgent and comforting. The noodles are chewy and firm, soaking up the broth beautifully without becoming soggy. The vegetable flakes and seasoning add just the right amount of texture and depth, making it more than just a quick meal—it’s an experience.
Notes / Annotator Comments: Broth taste/spice, noodle texture and vegetable/seasoning texture.
